svg.title: Print operator — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as print operator, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A broad printing roller feeds a separate sheet bearing two clear printed lines. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a tapered face and round glasses.
